content: {"paper_id":"W1987083125","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"The inter-level relationship constraint, e.g., a plant image must first be assigned to a parent node (high-level non-leaf node) correctly if it can further be assigned to the most relevant child node (low-level non-leaf node or leaf node) on the visual tree, is formally defined and leveraged to learn more discriminative tree classifiers over the visual tree.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要显式定义并利用父子节点/类别之间的层级依赖与约束来联合学习分类器，属于对标签间依赖或局部相关结构的显式建模。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"classifier-ensemble","reason_zh":"虽提到多个相互关联的树分类器联合训练，但未说明通过投票、加权或样本专家分配等方式集成预测，难以确认满足分类器集成定义。"}],"input_issues":[]}
